title: Cloud Vault For Photos & Files
summary: Secure Photos & Documents Vault with Google Drive, Dropbox & OneDrive Cloud Sync
description:
Secure your private files and back them up across multiple clouds—effortlessly.

Cloud Vault is the ultimate privacy app that protects your photos, videos, and documents with powerful encryption and seamless cloud integration.

🔐 Multi-cloud backup made simple
Sync your private files to Google Drive, Dropbox, and OneDrive—all at once. Manage, back up, and access your data anytime, anywhere—without switching apps or accounts.

🔧 Key Features:
Connect and sync with Google Drive, Dropbox & OneDrive
Automatic multi-cloud backup for your photos, videos, and documents
Encrypted storage with PIN, fingerprint & face ID
Break-in alerts with photo & GPS
Decoy password for added privacy
Hide the app from recent apps list
Whether you're protecting sensitive documents or personal memories, Cloud Vault ensures your data is always safe—and always backed up.

Download Cloud Vault and take control of your privacy in the cloud!
